BattleOpersShadowPuppetFlag.Doc: Rightmost shadow-puppet card C-marker anchor in normalized1280x720 battle frames. Used only after both colored border checks and ordinary role validation.

BattleOpersShadowPuppetPink.colorScales_Doc: HSV border color; requires a broad pink top band, not a portrait color.
BattleOpersShadowPuppetPink.specialParams_Doc: Minimum matching pixels in the border ROI.

BattleOpersShadowPuppetCyan.colorScales_Doc: HSV border color; requires a broad cyan bottom band in the same card.
BattleOpersShadowPuppetCyan.specialParams_Doc: Minimum matching pixels in the border ROI.

BattleOpersShadowPuppetUnitLimit.Doc: Read the rightmost available deployment-slot digit; unknown or0 fails closed for highlighted cards.
